[2/6] Attempt authority: schema v6 test_attempt ledger, earliest non-replaceable attempt selects the NUMERIC evidence group

impact_assessment.why: The current evidence path accepts any current verified group, so a later pass can displace an earlier subject failure and reopen retry-until-pass
impact_assessment.benefits: Every execution is an attempt; the earliest non-replaceable attempt is authoritative; attempt history is visible, exported and checked
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new test_attempt table and schema 6; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transactions; state: legacy runs without an attempt row keep the old any-current-group behaviour
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for authority selection, run classification and migration; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Attempt authority delivered: schema 6 test_attempt ledger, earliest non-replaceable attempt selects the NUMERIC group, test attempts command, legacy fallback; 332 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[3/6] Claim revisions: schema 7 revision_of/superseded_by, claim revise/history, edges repointed to the head, old claim kept as history

impact_assessment.why: Claim text is immutable, so a refined claim either becomes a silently contradicting second claim or leaves a stale statement in the graph
impact_assessment.benefits: A revision chain keeps the old text and verdict history visible while the head carries the live edges; reports and lists hide superseded heads by default
impact_assessment.risks: contract: three additive claim columns and schema 7; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transaction; state: edges move to the head, tests stay on the old claim and warn
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for chain creation, provenance refusal, edge repointing, list/history views and migration; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [3/6] Claim revisions delivered: schema 7 revision links, claim revise/history, edges move to the head, superseded heads hidden, REV-001/REV-002 warnings; 342 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[4/6] Measurement provenance and protocol comparability: schema 8 observation provenance, protocol registry, stats comparability gate, OBS-002

impact_assessment.why: Observations store only claim/group/value, so a number cannot be traced to the instrument, rater or protocol that produced it, and two accuracy numbers can be compared silently
impact_assessment.benefits: Every new measurement can carry instrument, rater, protocol, sample size, aggregation and unit; stats refuses cross-protocol or cross-instrument comparisons unless explicitly allowed with a caveat
impact_assessment.risks: contract: observation columns and a protocol table, schema 8; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transactions; state: legacy observations remain readable and warn OBS-002
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first validation, comparability and migration tests; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [4/6] Measurement provenance delivered: schema 8 observation provenance, immutable protocol registry, comparability gate with --allow-incomparable, report provenance columns, OBS-002; 356 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[5/6] Nested event provenance: schema 9 seq/root_id/parent_id, event tree and path, same-program parent validation

impact_assessment.why: The event log is flat, so a reviewer cannot see which action caused a cascade, merge or report write
impact_assessment.benefits: Every new event carries a per-program sequence and a root/parent link; events tree and events path render the causal chain
impact_assessment.risks: contract: three event columns and schema 9; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: sequence allocated inside the writer transaction; state: legacy events default to root-less seq 0
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first nesting, orphan, cross-program and CLI tests; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [5/6] Nested event provenance delivered: schema 9 seq/root_id/parent_id, events tree/path, same-program parent validation, legacy event fallback; 362 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass; checklists: passed
[6/6] Self-produced metric quarantine: schema 10 observation provenance class, producer path/digest, stats gate and report split, OBS-003/OBS-004

impact_assessment.why: A measurement produced by the system under study can enter the evidence base and be compared like an independent one
impact_assessment.benefits: Self-reported measurements are labelled, separated in reports and refused in comparisons unless explicitly allowed with a caveat
impact_assessment.risks: contract: three observation columns and schema 10; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transactions; state: legacy measurements are unclassified and warn OBS-003
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first class validation, stats refusal, report split and migration tests; full suite and 4/4 gates before commit
